tvShow.name: A Trap Called Desire
tvShow.overview: Falsely accused of murder, a woman loses everything overnight. Determined to reclaim her stolen life, she uncovers a far-reaching conspiracy as she exposes hidden truths and confronts the powerful figures who sacrificed innocent lives to protect their own ambitions.

episodes.name: Jealousy Takes A Dark Turn
episodes.overview: Fueled by bitter envy over Ko Eun Seol, Kang Hae Ra loses her mind and marches straight to the school art room

episodes.name: Truth Beneath The Ashes
episodes.overview: Cha Seok Jin saves Ko Eun Seol from the fire as Joo Mi Ran plots and Eun Seol's painful birth secret surfaces.

episodes.name: When The Past Appears
episodes.overview: After her suspension, Ko Eun Seol is shunned at home as Park Hee Jung unexpectedly meets Joo Mi Ran at school.

episodes.name: Eun Seol's Biological Mother
episodes.overview: Hee Jung uncovers a clue about Eun Seol's biological mother, while Seok Jin and Eun Seol go on a date.

episodes.name: Ae Sook’s Evil Scheme
episodes.overview: Ae Sook comes up with an evil scheme against Hee Jung, who keeps cornering her by exposing the truth.

episodes.name: The Flames Of Cold Revenge
episodes.overview: After Mi Ran frames her for murder, Ko Eun Seol survives prison with an unbreakable vow for revenge.

episodes.name: The Hunt For Lost Justice
episodes.overview: Cast out by her family upon release, Ko Eun Seol starts chasing the false witness to clear her name.

episodes.name: Webs Of Deceit And Ambition
episodes.overview: As Ko Eun Seol pursues a false witness, Joo Mi Ran plots to bring Cha Seok Jin back for Kang Hae Ra.

episodes.name: Closing In On The Truth
episodes.overview: Ko Eun Seol gets closer to the truth after discovering the perjured witness's connection to Cheongma Group.

episodes.name: A Way Into Cheongma
episodes.overview: Ko Eun Seol decides to enter a design competition to overcome Kang Hae Ra and join Cheongma.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After being branded a murderer, a woman begins a dangerous fight to uncover the truth behind the conspiracy that destroyed her life. As she tracks down those responsible and exposes the secrets hidden beneath their success, she faces powerful enemies determined to keep the past buried.
